sentences.en: RAID-1 focuses on reliability, at the expense of storage size.
sentences.zh: RAID-1 注重可靠性，但以牺牲存储空间为代价。

sentences.en: Cosby's argument concerns the reliability of the Hette Manuscript.
sentences.zh: 科斯比的论点涉及赫特手稿的可信度问题。

sentences.en: All he has going for him is his reliability.
sentences.zh: 他唯一的优势就是他的可靠。
